## Any language beside the animation

The second block is simply the one that is not the manim block; nothing
downstream cares about its language.

::: {.explain-code-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("borrow")
```
